crosswalk_scope.project_reference: GRCh38.p14 plus GENCODE v49; retain source-native build until a loss-audited crosswalk is frozen

compatibility_finding.held_evidence_source: Conditionally compatible only for candidate pairs whose endpoints remain in the graph through nonheld sources. Refit walks and embeddings after the entire source and derivatives are removed.
compatibility_finding.held_ld_or_gene_block: Incompatible with scoring a fully isolated held block under the registered split. Removing all held-block incident edges removes the topology needed to learn its node embeddings; such rows are untestable, not negative.
compatibility_finding.inductive_behavior: None. A predeclared but isolated node receives no topology-trained representation even if num_nodes reserves an index.
compatibility_finding.sealed_source_recovery: No current seal exists. For a future seal, node2vec can be only a common-support transductive comparator, not a full-denominator champion, unless the prespecified endpoint explicitly permits nonheld support and the coverage rule is locked before unblinding.

endpoint_eligibility.brier_score: Eligible on the frozen common-support subset only after inner-source logistic calibration; raw dot products are not probabilities.
endpoint_eligibility.held_source_auprc: Development-eligible on retained-node common support. Ineligible for source-only nodes or fully isolated held blocks.
endpoint_eligibility.locus_macro_hits_at_10: Development-eligible only for loci with a frozen nonheld-supported candidate denominator; disclose excluded loci.
endpoint_eligibility.locus_macro_mrr: Development-eligible only for loci with a frozen nonheld-supported candidate denominator; disclose excluded loci.
endpoint_eligibility.typed_or_directed_claim: Ineligible because the projection discards edge type, evidence source, direction, and weight.

graph_construction_contract.candidate_universe: Evaluator-owned typed candidate pairs, frozen independently of held outcomes. The model adapter receives pair IDs only after its embedding and node coverage map are committed.
graph_construction_contract.held_blocks: Remove all incident edges for native-build ancestry-aware LD blocks, loci within 1 Mb, and gene blocks before node mapping, walks, random negatives, or any normalization. Do not preserve a held node by adding a target-derived self-loop.
graph_construction_contract.held_source: Remove its edges and every deterministic thresholded, aggregated, mirrored, ontology-projected, or source-release duplicate before graph collapse. An independently measured edge from another retained source may remain with explicit provenance.
graph_construction_contract.negative_sampling: Use the exact native random-context sampler over the retained node universe. Do not inspect held positives to exclude false negatives; report the closed-world bias.
graph_construction_contract.projection: After source and block removal, union the retained edges, canonicalize typed pairs, collapse duplicates, discard weights/source counts, and emit a stable undirected edge_index.
graph_construction_contract.row_identity: Hash the ordered typed node map. Different held sources, held blocks, or seeds have distinct embedding artifact IDs even when dimensions match.

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Exposed training/development topology only after the corrected 50-study release is promoted. Keep study, trait, build, locus, COLOC provenance, and observability outside any causal-gene claim. Provisional current memberships cannot define a frozen graph.

gse281160.allowed_use: Mechanistic development or pseudo-held source only after experimental-replicate aggregation and guide-target joins. When held, remove direct and program/target/gene derivative edges before graph collapse. Cells and guides are not replicates.

gse281364.allowed_use: Mechanistic development or pseudo-held source only after oligo, allele, barcode, count, context, replicate, and build joins. When held, remove direct MPRA and every derived evidence edge before graph collapse.

split_and_leakage_rules.artifact_scope: Train one new node2vec model per outer held-source by held-block split and seed. Precomputing one full-graph embedding and slicing it by fold is target leakage.
split_and_leakage_rules.derivatives: The retained node universe, degree, connected components, edge multiplicity collapse, walk corpus, random-negative distribution, source-overlap status, calibration, and coverage are graph-derived and must be recomputed after every holdout.
split_and_leakage_rules.selection: Select recipe, epoch count, decoder, calibrator, and coverage rule using development pseudo-held sources only. Seeds quantify stability and are not inferential replicates.
split_and_leakage_rules.sealed_protocol: For any future seal, commit graph, node roster, five embeddings, supported candidate denominator, raw scores, calibration, and untestable states before the evaluator joins source outcomes.

coverage_and_missingness.both_endpoints_supported: Score only if both nodes have at least one retained non-self edge and finite embeddings in every admitted seed.
coverage_and_missingness.reporting: Report full candidate count, scored count, pair and locus coverage, and coverage by node type, source, degree, observability, and held block. Never encode an absent embedding as zeros.
coverage_and_missingness.semantic_distinction: A low score for a supported pair is unsupported model evidence. Missing retained topology is untestable.
